verdict.rationale: This is a fair question for a SaaS email client that publishes docs, but the evidence shows no llms.txt or agent-oriented docs. Direct probes returned HTTP 404 for /llms.txt, the markdown docs variant, and all OpenAPI paths. The MCP-client integrations Shortwave offers are a different capability and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
